acceptanceCriteria: Superseded historical predecessors with valid recovery and close evidence are classified as recovered in all three parity projections.
The gate requires the selected recovery decision path and close decision path and does not report stale parity status for a recovered item.
A regression fixture covers a close decision with approved humanDecision plus a later supersede receipt, preserving immutable predecessor bytes.
Object repositories and historical generated bytes are not modified.
goal: Ensure historical recovery closures have a deterministic, auditable parity projection and regression coverage before release.
intent: Make CI governance parity project historical supersede recovery and close decisions without false stale/missing failures.
